facts.value: As part of your program in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Business Administration, known as export modules of the Department of Business Administration - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.

For the study programs of other departments, an overview has been compiled showing which export modules you can register for in the Department of Business Administration and how you can integrate these export modules into your program in your department.

Furthermore, you cannot integrate any other modules from the Department of Business Administration into your program in another department and also cannot earn any different credit points (CP) at the Department of Business Administration.
